_about: Settings for family-based filings (src/family.py) that change every year and must come from the official source, never from memory. poverty_guidelines: USCIS Form I-864P (uscis.gov/i-864p), read 2026-10-01. 'Effective beginning Mar. 1, 2026'. Three regions; the sponsor's state chooses (AK -> alaska, HI -> hawaii, everything else -> contiguous: the 48 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands). 'p125' is the minimum for most sponsors; 'p100' for a sponsor on active duty in the U.S. armed forces petitioning for their spouse or child. Note: the USCIS page also shows an unlabelled table above these three with older (2023-level) amounts; it is not used. The filing fees are in schemas/fees.json.

poverty_guidelines.source: USCIS Form I-864P, HHS Poverty Guidelines for Affidavit of Support (uscis.gov/i-864p)
